title: Teleportation Crystals
description: This datapack allows you to craft crystals that store your location and allow you to teleport back to it!
body:
This datapack creates Teleportation Crystals! On first join, you will be given 1 teleportation crystal and the recipe to craft it.

- You will need 4 amethyst shards, 1 compass, and 4 empty maps to create 1 Teleportation Crystal. You can change this recipe yourself in the files!
- Right clicking with the crystal in your hand will give you a Resonating Teleportation crystal that looks like an enchanted echo shard, it will also show you the coordinates in the items description so that you can keep track of which crystals will take you where!
- Hold down right click while holding your Resonating Teleportation Crystal to be teleported back to the coordinates you saved! This breaks the crystal!

The actual item is a wooden pic that has the tool and max damage components removed, that way you wont accidentally use the "amethyst shard" or "echo shard" in a crafting recipe. They also wont behave like a wooden pic
